response.sql: SELECT p.SEX, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(l.DNA), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_anti_dna, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS avg_albumin_minus_total_protein FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`T-CHO` >= 180 GROUP BY p.SEX

assumptions.assumption: The cholesterol cutoff selects values at or above 180; the request does not specify which side of the cutoff to keep.
Nonblank DNA values are numeric text.
